'''Kenta Kamakari''' (Japanese: '''鎌苅健太''' ''Kamakari Kenta'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Kamakari was born on February 17, 1984, in {{wp|Osaka Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He started work on the {{pkmn|animated series}} with {{aniseries|SM}}, where he voiced [[DJ Leo]]. Kamakari is currently affiliated with talent group Yzpapa.

In addition to being a voice actor, Kamakari is also an actor and singer. He was the leader and vocalist of the band Cocoa Otoko that was active from April 2010 until its final performance on March 31 2012.
